title: Cost decomposition of the learner
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean target, let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$, and let $M\in\mathbb{N}$ with $M>0$. For every output and cost pair in the support of the Kushilevitz–Mansour program run against $f$, there are a first-stage outcome and a second-stage outcome, each in the support of the corresponding stage run, such that the output of the full run is the second-stage output and its cost is the sum of the two stage costs, component by component.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean target on the $n$-dimensional cube
the outcome pair belongs to the support of the full run with cost
